name: Toaststripe Minnow
flavor: Looks like it has been lightly toasted along the edges.
sprite_brief: Small sand fish, cream belly, coral lateral stripe, rounded navy eye, forked tail.

name: Pebblelip Dace
flavor: Investigates every pebble as if it might be breakfast.
sprite_brief: Slim moss fish, sand lips, cream flank dots, sky fins, short forked tail.

name: Mintcomma Sprat
flavor: A tiny green comma in the river's long sentence.
sprite_brief: Mint curved body, cream belly, navy comma spot, clear sky fins.

name: Sandskip Goby
flavor: Hops along the bottom with absolutely nowhere urgent to be.
sprite_brief: Sand stout goby, moss freckles, cream round cheeks, wide coral pectoral fins.

name: Crumbfin Bream
flavor: Follows picnics with suspicious dedication.
sprite_brief: Deep cream oval fish, moss back, coral blunt fins, sand cheek scales.

name: Ribbonwink Shiner
flavor: Flashes a friendly little wink whenever it turns.
sprite_brief: Sky slender shiner, bright cream side stripe, lilac tail, navy round eye.

name: Teadrop Loach
flavor: Settles into the silt like a biscuit into a cup.
sprite_brief: Sand long loach, moss saddle marks, cream barbels, coral rounded tail.

name: Mossbutton Perch
flavor: Wears its spots like a very tidy set of buttons.
sprite_brief: Moss oval perch, cream button spots, navy dorsal spikes, sand belly, coral fins.

name: Puddlequilt Carp
flavor: A patchwork shimmer in the shallows.
sprite_brief: Rounded sand carp, mint and cream square scales, moss whiskers, coral tail.

name: Skythread Smelt
flavor: Stitches a thin blue line through cold water.
sprite_brief: Long sky fish, cream narrow belly, navy eye, translucent mint forked tail.

name: Oatflake Mullet
flavor: Always seems to have a few crumbs stuck to its scales.
sprite_brief: Sand broad fish, cream scattered scale flecks, moss back stripe, blunt navy nose.

name: Lilacwhisk Gudgeon
flavor: Searches the riverbed with two very serious whiskers.
sprite_brief: Lilac slim fish, cream chin barbels, sand speckles, moss small fins.

name: Cupnose Sculpin
flavor: Its broad little face looks ready for a warm drink.
sprite_brief: Sand broad headed sculpin, moss mottled back, cream cup shaped mouth, wide navy fins.

name: Reedflash Tetra
flavor: The reeds always seem livelier after it passes.
sprite_brief: Mint small diamond fish, coral side dash, cream translucent fins, navy eye.

name: Coralcrumb Sardine
flavor: Travels in a crowd and still brings its own snack.
sprite_brief: Slender coral sardine, cream belly, sky back line, tiny sand forked tail.

name: Softspine Stickleback
flavor: Its brave little spines never quite spoil its sweet face.
sprite_brief: Moss tiny fish, three cream dorsal spines, rose throat, sky rounded fins.

name: Butterwake Bleak
flavor: Leaves a warm gold flicker in the afternoon water.
sprite_brief: Slim gold fish, cream side sheen, sand dorsal line, coral split tail.

name: Navynose Herring
flavor: Arrives quietly, usually with a hundred equally quiet cousins.
sprite_brief: Sky herring, navy rounded snout, cream belly, gold eye ring, narrow forked tail.

name: Pebblepin Shrimp
flavor: Carries its elbows very politely.
sprite_brief: Tiny translucent sand shrimp, coral joints, cream antennae, moss tail fan.

name: Mintcap Limpet
flavor: Sticks to its plans with admirable confidence.
sprite_brief: Low mint cone shell, cream radial ridges, sand oval foot, navy rim shadow.

name: Sandloop Cockle
flavor: Keeps a small seaside secret behind its ridged shell.
sprite_brief: Sand heart shaped shell, cream radiating ribs, coral hinge, navy outline.

name: Creamcurl Whelk
flavor: A little spiral with nowhere it would rather be.
sprite_brief: Cream spiral shell, moss mottled bands, sand opening, coral soft foot.

name: Siltstep Boot
flavor: One well-traveled boot, still hoping to meet its other half.
sprite_brief: Old sand ankle boot, navy cracked sole, moss silt patches, coral broken lace.

name: Rattlelip Tin
flavor: A dented tin with a very modest underwater music career.
sprite_brief: Dented charcoal tin can, cream torn label, coral rust patches, bent gold pull ring.

name: Frayloop Rope
flavor: Too frayed for sailing, just right for a very untidy bow.
sprite_brief: Coiled sand rope, moss algae tufts, cream frayed ends, navy wet shadow.

name: Driftspoke Wheel
flavor: A toy wagon wheel that took the scenic route to the shore.
sprite_brief: Small worn wooden wheel, sand broken spokes, charcoal hub, moss seaweed strand.

name: Chipwink Cup
flavor: A chipped cup with enough dignity left for holding pebbles.
sprite_brief: Cream cracked cup, coral chipped handle, navy faded stripe, sand sediment inside.

name: Snaggletoe Sock
flavor: The sea has officially declined to keep this sock.
sprite_brief: Limp navy sock, cream worn toe hole, coral stripe, moss tangled thread.

name: Honeypatch Tench
flavor: Finds the warmest patch of water and stays for tea.
sprite_brief: Plump gold tench, moss back patches, cream lips, coral rounded fins.

name: Reedribbon Eel
flavor: Slips through the reeds like a ribbon looking for a parcel.
sprite_brief: Long moss eel, cream ribbon side stripe, sand fin fringe, navy nose.

name: Rosefin Chub
flavor: A rosy splash beneath the first drifting petals.
sprite_brief: Sand sturdy chub, rose fins, cream belly, moss large scales, navy eye.

name: Tinysail Garlet
flavor: Raises its little sail whenever the evening breeze arrives.
sprite_brief: Slim sky garlet, navy long snout, coral sail dorsal fin, cream dotted sides.

name: Cobbleback Barbel
flavor: Rootles through stones as though hunting a lost button.
sprite_brief: Moss barbel, sand cobble spots, cream four chin barbels, coral tail.

name: Quiltstripe Bass
flavor: Its tidy stripes make the whole pond look better dressed.
sprite_brief: Navy thick bass, cream broken stripes, moss dorsal fin, sand jaw, coral gills.

name: Skydimple Trout
flavor: Each pale spot looks like a tiny reflection of the sky.
sprite_brief: Sky trout, cream round dimples, lilac lateral wash, navy fins, coral gill mark.

name: Sandspoon Flounder
flavor: Hides under sand with the confidence of a misplaced spoon.
sprite_brief: Flat sand oval flounder, cream pebble spots, moss rim fins, two navy upper eyes.

name: Clovercheek Bluegill
flavor: Wears a little leaf-shaped mark beside its grin.
sprite_brief: Mint deep fish, moss clover cheek patch, cream belly, coral fin tips.

name: Brinebutton Mackerel
flavor: A row of little spots keeps its stripes from getting too serious.
sprite_brief: Navy mackerel, sky back bars, cream side buttons, sand pointed head.

name: Liltfin Wrasse
flavor: Dances around rocks to a tune only it can hear.
sprite_brief: Coral slim wrasse, mint curved stripes, cream lower jaw, lilac rounded fins.

name: Ochrecurl Pipefish
flavor: Practices looking like a reed, then forgets and wiggles.
sprite_brief: Thin gold pipefish, moss ring bands, cream long snout, coral curled tail tip.

name: Frostwhisk Codlet
flavor: One small chin whisker is all the winter coat it needs.
sprite_brief: Sky stocky codlet, navy speckles, cream chin barbel, sand broad tail.

name: Plumspot Puffer
flavor: Gets rounder when surprised by its own reflection.
sprite_brief: Cream round puffer, plum large spots, mint tiny spines, coral puckered mouth.

name: Reedlace Glassfish
flavor: Looks as though someone forgot to finish painting it.
sprite_brief: Transparent mint fish, cream fine spine, sky fin outlines, navy eye, coral heart dot.

name: Peachpeel Killi
flavor: A tiny bright curl in the edge of the pond.
sprite_brief: Coral small killi, cream diagonal scale marks, gold tail fan, moss dorsal stripe.

name: Amberwink Squidlet
flavor: Blinks amber when it has a particularly good idea.
sprite_brief: Gold short squid, cream dotted mantle, coral fins, moss curled arms, navy eyes.

name: Brinebow Prawn
flavor: Its antennae make every entrance feel like a flourish.
sprite_brief: Coral curved prawn, cream segmented bands, navy tail fan, gold long antennae.

name: Oatstone Mussel
flavor: A modest shell with a surprisingly polished lining.
sprite_brief: Navy oval mussel, sand oat shaped freckles, cream open lip, lilac inner sheen.

name: Twineclaw Crayfish
flavor: Keeps both claws busy with absolutely confidential pond business.
sprite_brief: Moss crayfish, sand rope patterned claws, coral joints, cream belly plates, navy tail.

name: Lanternstripe Pike
flavor: A bright stripe arrives before the rest of its long shadow.
sprite_brief: Long navy pike, gold side stripe, cream jaw, moss pointed fins, coral eye ring.

name: Petalveil Betta
flavor: Every turn unfolds another small bouquet of fins.
sprite_brief: Rose small fish, wide lilac petal fins, cream scalloped edges, mint body stripe.

name: Pearlpatch Koi
flavor: Looks carefully patched together from pieces of moonlit cloud.
sprite_brief: Cream rounded koi, sky pearl patches, gold scales, coral fin tips, moss barbels.

name: Velvetwake Catfish
flavor: A velvety shadow with whiskers fit for a grand storyteller.
sprite_brief: Plum broad catfish, cream long whiskers, navy back, gold eye rings, sand fins.

name: Tidefold Locket
flavor: Inside is a tiny empty frame, ready for a new happy memory.
sprite_brief: Gold oval locket, coral hinge, cream blank inset, navy tarnish along scalloped rim.

name: Brinebell Coin
flavor: A worn coin from a harbor whose name the waves have forgotten.
sprite_brief: Round gold coin, cream bell relief, moss patina pits, navy uneven edge.

name: Duneglass Sole
flavor: So clear and sandy that the sun seems to pass right through.
sprite_brief: Flat translucent sand sole, cream edge glints, sky internal swirls, two navy eyes.

name: Hushribbon Moray
flavor: A ribbon of shadow with a surprisingly shy smile.
sprite_brief: Long charcoal moray, plum ribbon bands, lilac fin edge, cream small jaw teeth.

name: Moonbutton Sunfish
flavor: Round enough to look like the pond lost a very large button.
sprite_brief: Cream round sunfish, sky circular spots, navy tall fins, gold tiny mouth.

name: Reefruff Lionfish
flavor: A fancy fan of spines with an admirably unhurried fan dance.
sprite_brief: Coral lionfish, cream stripes, lilac long fin rays, navy eye, sand wide pectoral fans.

name: Chartcurl Nautilus
flavor: Its spiral seems to contain a map of every tide.
sprite_brief: Cream spiral shell, navy chartlike bands, gold central whorl, coral short tentacles.

name: Wishscale Gourami
flavor: Every pale scale seems to hold a small hopeful thought.
sprite_brief: Mint deep gourami, gold diamond scales, cream feeler fins, coral tail edging.

name: Sugarfin Trigger
flavor: Bright as a sweet wrapper and twice as difficult to fold.
sprite_brief: Plum diamond fish, rose diagonal bands, cream angular fins, gold beak, mint tail.

name: Mossmosaic Lobster
flavor: Wears a mosaic coat to every quiet seabed gathering.
sprite_brief: Moss lobster, cream mosaic shell patches, coral joints, gold broad claws, navy antennae.

name: Orbitglow Oarfish
flavor: A long silver ribbon carrying a pocketful of starlight.
sprite_brief: Long cream ribbon fish, sky flank stars, coral crest, gold fin rays, navy eyes.

name: Coralchorus Sailfish
flavor: Its great sail looks ready to lead the morning's first song.
sprite_brief: Navy sleek sailfish, coral broad sail, cream wave marks, gold bill, sky tail.

name: Frostlace Sturgeon
flavor: Its pale armor looks knitted by the coldest tide.
sprite_brief: Sky sturgeon, cream lace patterned scutes, navy pointed snout, gold barbels, lilac tail.

name: Hushbell Angler
flavor: Rings no bell, but its little light still invites curious company.
sprite_brief: Plum round anglerfish, cream lure bulb on gold stalk, charcoal fins, lilac small teeth.

name: Petalwake Manta
flavor: Glides beneath drifting petals without disturbing a single one.
sprite_brief: Wide rose manta, cream underside, mint petal back marks, navy long tail, gold eyes.

name: Giltthread Arowana
flavor: A golden thread stitching slow circles across the pond.
sprite_brief: Long gold arowana, cream plate scales, coral barbels, plum narrow fins, navy eye.

name: Shellscript Key
flavor: A shell-shaped key still waiting for its little seaside door.
sprite_brief: Gold ornate key, cream shell bow, coral enamel grooves, moss patina teeth.

name: Aurorawoven Leviathan
flavor: A ribbon of northern light that briefly forgot to be a sky.
sprite_brief: Long sky whale-fish, mint aurora bands, lilac streaming fins, cream belly, gold star flecks.

name: Dawncrown Coelacanth
flavor: Carries a quiet crown of light from an age of slower mornings.
sprite_brief: Plum heavy fish, gold crownlike dorsal lobes, cream scale rings, coral fleshy fins, sky eyes.

name: Moonkeel Chest
flavor: The tide has polished its corners through a thousand sleepy evenings.
sprite_brief: Navy small sea chest, gold crescent latch, cream shell inlays, coral hinge bands, moss barnacle dots.
